_comment: Human-reviewed decisions for BOM lines that cannot be resolved mechanically.
Each entry is applied INSTEAD of automatic resolution, and every choice is
re-verified against the element14 API at run time. 'why' is copied into the
BOM notes so the reasoning survives.
Keys are reference designators (any ref in the group may be used).

U7.why: Value 'ATmega16U2-A' is the TQFP-32 part but the footprint is VQFN-32; -MU is the VQFN package

U8.why: footprint is SOIC-16W (wide); ADuM4160BRIZ is the narrow-SOIC variant and would not fit

Y1.why: Value was unset (it held the footprint name). Footprint is a 5.0x3.2mm 4-pad crystal; ABM3 is 16MHz in exactly that package

Y2.why: Value was a CSTCE16M0V53-R0 3-terminal resonator (No Longer Manufactured) but the footprint is the same 4-pad 5.0x3.2mm crystal as Y1, so treat as a 16MHz crystal

Q2.why: FDD5614P (60V P-ch, 15A, 0.1ohm, TO-252) is No Longer Manufactured. SUD19P06-60-GE3 is 60V, 18.3A, 0.06ohm, same TO-252 footprint - meets or beats every rating

J15.why: symbol is Conn_01x04 with a Phoenix MPT-0,5/4-2,54 footprint, but Value/MPN were the stale 2-pin JST B2B-XH. Corrected to the 4-way part used by J11/J13/J16/J20

JP1.why: PinHeader_2x01_P2.54mm_Vertical - Molex KK 1x02 2.54mm THT. Replaces 640456-2, which has MOQ 100 (bulk) - we want individual parts

JP2.why: PinHeader_1x02_P2.54mm_Vertical - same 2-pin header as JP1; MOQ 10 not 100

D6.why: Value was 'SS24A+'; the trailing '+' is a lead-free suffix, the element14 MPN is SS24A. 40V 2A SMA matches the D_SMA footprint

D9.why: Value was just 'YELLOW'; footprint is LED_0402. Kingbright 150040YS73240 is a yellow 0402 LED

J1.why: 23-way 2.54mm single-row socket, 8.5mm insulation height, 3mm tails, gold-flash contacts. 260 in stock, MOQ 5 = $1.15. Socket hangs below the interface board and receives the 15.75mm posts of J3 across the fixed 20.00mm standoff gap (socket body bottom at 11.5mm, pin tip at 15.75mm). Backup: HC-PM254-8.5H-1x24PZ = C41376163 (15714 stock, cut one position).

J2.why: Same part as J1 - the LPT interface board's socket. Only one interface board is connected at a time, so J1/J2 are alternatives, not a pair.

J3.why: 23-way single-row 2.54mm THT header, .025in square posts, tin, lead style 17 = .620in (15.75mm) post above a 2.54mm plastic body, .830in (21.08mm) overall. The long post is what reaches the interface-board sockets across the fixed 20.00mm stack: measured requirement is 16.0 +/-0.25mm above the controller PCB, geometry says 15.75-16.25mm, and 15.75mm is the only stocked lead style in that window (-15 is 13.21mm, -18 is 18.29mm and would bottom out). In stock at Samtec, $1.516 ea. Exact-height alternative if 15.75mm proves marginal: MTSW-123-10-T-S-630 (.630in = 16.00mm post), build-to-order, no stock. Tail is 2.79mm = 1.19mm proud of a 1.6mm board.

D7.why: BAT54KFILM is the SOD-523 version of the same BAT54 die (40V 300mA single Schottky). BAT54JFILM is SOD-323 - 1.9mm pad pitch vs the 1.4mm SOD-523 land pattern on the board - and is zero stock.

D8.why: BAT54KFILM is the SOD-523 version of the same BAT54 die (40V 300mA single Schottky). BAT54JFILM is SOD-323 - 1.9mm pad pitch vs the 1.4mm SOD-523 land pattern on the board - and is zero stock.

D11.why: BAT54KFILM is the SOD-523 version of the same BAT54 die (40V 300mA single Schottky). BAT54JFILM is SOD-323 - 1.9mm pad pitch vs the 1.4mm SOD-523 land pattern on the board - and is zero stock.

L2.why: 0805 MLV, 5.6V working / 18V clamp - closest 0805 equivalent of the 0603 ChipGuard it replaces. NOTE: the schematic Value still says CG0603MLC-05E, which is a 0603 part.

L3.why: 10uH 0603 multilayer, 250mA, 1.05 ohm. L3 sits between +5VA and the ATmega328P AVCC pin, so the current is only a few mA - the 250mA rating is ample.

SW3.why: 3.9x3.0x2.0mm SMD vertical tactile, SPST-NO 12V/50mA. Footprint SW_Push_1P1T_NO_XUNPU_TS-1088-AR02016 (2 pads 1.05x2.00mm, 3.40mm gap, 4.45mm pitch). Local stock; also available to PCBWay from their catalogue.

J7.why: Male DB25 plug, right angle, THT, 25 contacts - confirmed correct (this was the original schematic part). Gender=Plug, 'Through Hole Mount Right Angle', 3142 in stock, and the cheapest option by a wide margin. Matches the DSUB-25_Pins_Horizontal 7.70mm-offset footprint.

K1.why: OJ series, VENTED, 24VDC, SPST-NO 10A, THT solder terminals - the closest in-stock element14 equivalent. Sealing is not required (Bryan). Coil is 1.28k = 450mW / 18.75mA versus the sealed part's 2.88k = 200mW / 8.3mA; the coil driver is Q5 (BC857, 100mA) so that is comfortably within rating. Contacts only switch the VFD digital input VFD_FWD, so 10A vs anything smaller is irrelevant. Board land pattern 7.62/12.70/2.54mm matches the OJ family.
K1.alternates: DigiKey OJS-SH-124HMF,00000 (sealed, 200mW, Class F, $4.14) | element14 3764773 = 2071556-2 (sealed 16A/450mW, $4.53, 0 stock, 24wk lead) | element14 OJ-SS-124LMHF,000 (vented, 200mW coil, Class F, but only 8A, $4.97)

R18.why: MULTICOMP consolidation: 5K6 0603 1% thick film, replaces the Vishay CRCW06035K60FKEA

C2.why: MULTICOMP consolidation: 1uF 50V 0603 X7R, replaces TDK C1608X5R1H105K080AB

C17.why: MULTICOMP consolidation: 100nF 50V 0402 X7R, replaces Murata GRM155R71H104KE14D

C16.why: MULTICOMP consolidation: 100nF 50V 0603 X7R, unified with C1 (same part, cheaper of the two listings)

C4.why: MULTICOMP consolidation: 100uF 35V SMD electrolytic, 8.0mm dia x 10.5mm - matches the CP_Elec_8x10.5 footprint exactly

C8.why: MULTICOMP consolidation: 68uF 35V SMD electrolytic, 6.3mm dia x 7.7mm - matches the CP_Elec_6.3x7.7 footprint exactly

C7.why: MULTICOMP consolidation (option b, chosen by Bryan): 22uF 16V 1206 X5R. MULTICOMP has no 22uF/25V 1206, so the schematic Value was changed to 22u/16V. Rail is the MAX5035 5V buck output, so 16V still gives 3.2x margin.
